architecture_classification.model_description: Candidate snapshot constructed by evaluate_canonical() -> Authoritative verification & atomic commit by CanonicalDecisionCommitAuthority -> Authoritative Canonical Decision

responsibilities: Evaluates FindingRegistry and CanonicalEvidenceManifest against CompiledDependencyPolicy
Derives theorem readiness and global provisioning readiness
Computes JCS-SHA256 canonical decision body and deterministic decision hash
Emits uncommitted candidate DecisionSnapshot
Verifies structural presence of required canonical hash bindings
Rejects invalidated pre-integration snapshots (PreIntegrationSnapshotRejectedError)
Rejects epoch-001 snapshot supplied as current canonical in epoch-002
Verifies canonical and authority eligibility flags
Enforces supplied_previous_decision_hash == authoritative_predecessor.decision_hash
Enforces requested_sequence == authoritative_predecessor.sequence + 1
Enforces requested_epoch == authoritative_predecessor.epoch
Verifies predecessor is not listed in invalidation registry
Verifies predecessor is not stale or already superseded
Fails closed with specific error types
Acquires concurrency lock for linearizable commit ordering
Validates structural snapshot and lineage prerequisites
Atomically transitions old CURRENT decision to SUPERSEDED
Atomically transitions new decision to CURRENT
Asserts exactly 1 CURRENT decision exists for active epoch
Persists append-only state to durable storage
